body:
This PR updates the calibration pipeline to

- use the new `SVDplusModelErrorCovariance` observation recipe,
- use the diagonal term machinery, 
- and use `ClimaCalibrate.@worker_setup` instead of `@everywhere`,

In addition, the CI step is updated to run the ensemble members serially. The build on CI is a bit flaky and can stall.
title: Update calibration pipeline to ClimaCalibrate v0.7
